title: Interns can't occupy chairs: Karnataka High Court asks for solution to overcrowding concerns
description: Courtroom 14 of the Karnataka High Court on Friday saw an exchange between the Bench and the Bar on persisting concerns about overcrowding in the courtroom.Justice M Nagaprasanna asked advocates to suggest solutions to tackle the problem, after concerns were raised that lawyers often find it difficult to move and find seating because of overcrowding, particularly in the latter half of the workday.
